description:
Your workouts and food, in one app.

Record a run, log lunch, look back at your week. Kinetta brings your activities, food and progress together, with choices about what you share.

WORKOUTS
Start an outdoor run, walk or ride from Track on iPhone. Switch between your map and live stats, then review the workout before saving. Use indoor timers, record lifting sets and follow your training history and lifting records. Follow a running plan or import supported workouts from Apple Health. Connect Garmin for new synced workouts; available details depend on the source.

FOOD
Log food by search, barcode, manual entry or a conversation with Kit. Save meals you make often, browse recipes and review weekly food insights. Mention your weight alongside a meal and review both before saving. AI estimates are optional; check foods, portions and nutrition before confirming them.

ASK KIT
Ask about your own workouts, meals and progress in plain language. Review your week, ask a follow-up or see a chart drawn from recorded data. Reopen saved conversations and continue where you left off. Kit can remember useful goals, preferences and routines; view, edit or delete those details, or turn memory off. Available features depend on the server and your permissions. Proposed goal changes need your confirmation.

PROGRESS
Explore achievements for running, riding, walking/hiking, swimming and lifting. See what you've earned and what comes next, alongside your recorded activity history.

FRIENDS AND CHALLENGES
Find friends, cheer activities, leave comments and catch up in Notifications. Join challenges for distance, active days, workouts, food logging days or protein-goal days. Choose Only me, Friends or Everyone for each activity. You can hide the ends of a shared route; the rest can still reveal location clues. Your food entries, weigh-ins and private Kit chats are not shared with friends.

HEALTH AND OPTIONAL AI
Apple Health is optional. Choose supported workout categories and, separately, body-weight readings to import. Kit requires your AI consent before relevant descriptions, photos or selected records go to the configured provider. Health and Garmin data have separate choices. Kit supports general fitness and food questions; it is not medical advice.

Kinetta is for people 16 or older; Kit is for people 18 or older. An account on a Kinetta server is required. Enrollment and optional services depend on that server. GPS recording and Apple Health features require the iPhone app. Export your data or delete your account in Settings.
